title: Plumeform header (v2)
description: A floating 52px pill bar that sticks 8px from the top: wordmark at the left, small centred links (some with chevrons), 'Log in' and a solid pill CTA at the right. Frosted paper with a hairline over light sections; it turns smoky dark glass by itself while it floats over a dark band. On phones: wordmark, CTA and a two-line menu button that opens the links inside the pill.
notes: sticky: put it at the top level of the page; it overlaps the first section by its own height plus 8px
it goes dark over any element inside a .dark ancestor (the plumeform-v2 bands use one)
the chevrons are decoration, not dropdowns
